title: Lineage 2/Beijing as a covariate
dek: L2 is over-represented in many MDR datasets. That is epidemiology plus maybe mutation supply — not a licence to call BDQ-R from a spoligotype.
story: Coll’s SNP barcode (and later expansions) assigns MTBC to lineages L1–L7, with L8/L9 rare. Lineage 2 (East-Asian, including Beijing families) is a successful human-adapted clade. It is over-represented among MDR/RR isolates in Eastern Europe, Central and East Asia, and some southern African outbreaks. That is transmission of already-resistant clones plus possibly a slightly higher mutation rate — both are hypotheses you test, not a DST rule.

Modern Beijing sublineages carried successful rpoB S450L plus compensatory rpoC alleles across continents. Ancient Beijing and non-Beijing L2 are not the same object. A “Beijing” label from old spoligotyping is coarser than a barcode.

PE/PPE content, PDIM/PGL, and DosR regulon nuances differ by lineage. None of that lets you skip katG. Lineage is a prior for interpretation (some fbi or pncA SNPs are phylogenetic) and a clustering covariate, not a drug.
deepTitle: How to write lineage on a gDST report
deep: Put lineage next to the SNP distance, not next to the BDQ call.
L4.3/LAM, L2.2.1, L1.1.1 each have known phylogenetic mutations that naive catalogues once graded as resistance. Version your catalogue.
Outbreak naming (W, GC1237, KZN) is local history. Map it to a barcode before comparing papers.
M. africanum L5/L6 is not “less TB.” It is human-adapted West African TB with a different RD pattern.

visual.caption: Lineage is nested phylogeny. Beijing is a family inside L2. MDR enrichment is an epidemiological layer, not a resistance gene.

example.title: Beijing plus silent rpoB
example.setup: L2.2.1 isolate, rpoB WT RRDR, phenotypic RIF-R. Someone says “Beijing explains discordant DST.”

steps.title: Lineage does not confer RR
steps.body: Look outside RRDR (N-terminal, disputed alleles) and at heteroresistance.

steps.title: Compensatory alleles need a driver
steps.body: rpoC compensatory mutations usually ride with RRDR R. Isolated rpoC is not the RIF call.

steps.title: Write the barcode
steps.body: L2.2.1 is epidemiology for the cluster, not a mechanism.

example.takeaway: Beijing is a clade, not a resistance gene.
